invalidPackageName.description: Error when a package is added under a name npm doesn't allow. {{name}} is the name as typed.

notOnNpm.description: Error when a package that isn't on the npm registry is added. {{name}} is the package name. npm is a product name.

noPublishedVersions.description: Error when a package on the npm registry has no version to add. {{name}} is the package name.

registryUnreachable.description: Error when the npm registry can't be reached, usually because the computer is offline. {{host}} is the registry's host name, such as registry.npmjs.org; keep it as it is.

registryStatus.description: Error when the npm registry answers with an error status. {{host}} is the registry's host name, {{status}} the HTTP status code, such as 500; keep both as they are.

registryInvalidResponse.message: {{host}} sent a response that couldn't be read.
registryInvalidResponse.description: Error when the npm registry's answer isn't valid JSON. {{host}} is the registry's host name; keep it as it is.
